A text a month. They saved more.
You meant to save this month. Then you forgot, right?
Researchers teamed up with banks in the Philippines, Peru and Bolivia.
People had just opened savings accounts, each with a goal.
Some got a reminder every month. Some got nothing.
The reminded ones saved about six percent more.
But in Peru, the letters that named their own goal did even better.
A photo of the goal? A puzzle of it? No real effect.
So name your goal in the reminder. Then let your phone nag you.
